Step1 : craete arepository and clone repository on local
stp2 : install playwright in automation ptoject 
         cmd : npm init plywrigt@lates

step 3: config playwright agent local using below command
          npx playwright init-agents --loop=vscode


step 4: It will craete .github folder and add custom agent in the .github
           1.Planner : This agent help us to create comprehensive test Plan
           2.Generator: This agent write automation with refrence of test planner
           3.Healer  : This agent will execute the test case and fix failures

step 5: it will aslo create .vscode folder. Then playwright mcp  config are available
           filename : playwright mcp.json


step 6 : create comprehensive test plan with the help of planner agent
           1.Go to AI chat window
           2.select agent link , all custom agent will be listed
           3.select palnner agent and provide prome to create test planner
          PROMPT : create a comprehensive test plan for given website
           https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/

           -> It will go each and every component of websit and create comprehensive plan

step 7 :Generat automation code with generator agents
         Prompt : implement automation code  1.Storefront navigation and content
             create page object model framework
             make sure test, pages, fixture, all folders should be on same,
             dont create any  folder insider test folder
             --implement new feature automation with page object model framework
